_comment: Defect declarations for the showcase replay clip (demos/showcase.json); see demos/README.md, Sidecar declarations.

overlap.reason: uid 7: an archer block that fights the routing uid 2 as it flees, then stands scrambled and is re-squared by the replay's next move order. On a 2-tick scan from the divergence (tick 951): closest body pair 0.648 wu (tick 1105) against the 2.25 wu floor, and 0.667 wu (tick 1219) on main 6e702b6a. The fight ends with its men a mean 65 wu from their own slots (tick 1080); at tick 1087 the replayed move order re-squares the block's formation fold by array index, which puts 12 of its 23 men's slots across the block's centreline (mean slot distance 132 wu), and two of the men crossing pass within 0.648 wu. The slot grid no longer swings after the router while it streams out through the block, which cleared this unit's misslotted verdict (0.478 to 0.130 against 0.25); the re-square of an arbitrary fold by index is a separate cause, tracked with this family in #1757 until it has its own issue.
